title: Dragonchic's Enchants
body:
### Have you ever imagined how would it be nice if some of Minecraft's enchantments were more useful? Now you don't have to imagine!

This DataPack improves some of the vanilla enchantments that weren't used much before or just could be better! Currently the improved enchantments are:


<details>
<summary>Frost walker</summary>

Now Frost walker I has a 4 block distance instead of 3 and it increases with 2 blocks per level instead of 1, which allows to sprint jump on water with Frost walker II.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Impaling</summary>

Now Impaling increases the damage to all mobs in water instead of only water mobs, similar to how Impaling works on Bedrock Edition.

</details>


I am planning to improve more enchantments later, please report bugs you find (the link is on this page).
